title: release: add artifact signing, provenance manifests, and release-manifest generation for private installer
author: Anya Patel
description: Motivation: Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) require cryptographic guarantees for installer artifacts and release manifests so customers can validate provenance in restricted environments. This PR adds automated artifact signing to the release pipeline, generates machine-readable provenance manifests (provenance.json) and a consolidated release-manifests.yaml that lists all installer artifacts, checksums and cosign signatures, and integrates SBOM generation for key artifacts. Changes are designed to be backwards-compatible with existing private install workflows and to support air-gapped validation by shipping portable signature files. What changed: 1) CI: expanded .github/workflows/release.yaml to include build -> sbom -> sign -> publish steps using sigstore/cosign; artifacts are published to the same S3/GCS bucket and OCI registry as before but now with accompanying .sig and provenance.json files. 2) tooling: new scripts/cosign-sign.sh wrapper to centralize signing behavior, support for cosign keyless and key-based modes, and offline key-material injection for air-gapped customers. 3) manifest generation: installer/tools/generate-release-manifest.go produces release-manifests.yaml containing artifact logical names, semver, SHA256, SBOM link, cosign signatures, and a provenance.json with build metadata (git ref, buildkit metadata, component versions). 4) Helm: bumped Chart.yaml and added provenance annotations and checksumFiles to values.yaml so the helm installer can validate before applying. 5) Terraform: module updates to allow installer pipelines to reference signed artifact URLs and to optionally verify signatures as part of the deployment. 6) Docs: docs/release/signing.md and ci/provenance/README.md document operator verification steps, recommended cosign versions, and air-gap key distribution pattern. Testing and rollout: CI includes integration tests that verify signature validity and manifest schema; a manual canary release was performed to a staging private cluster where the installer validated signatures and SBOM presence. Backwards compatibility: if downstream consumers do not consume signatures the pipeline still publishes unsigned artifacts for a short migration window (configurable), but signed artifacts are the default. Follow-ups: add OIDC key rotation guidance and automate manifest publishing to the internal attestation registry. See commits and changed_files for details.

feat(tooling): add generate-release-manifest.go and manifest schema v1

docs: add signing and verification guide for operators
test(ci): add integration tests for signed artifact validation
review_comments: Marco Liu: Please pin the cosign version and add a note about breaking changes in cosign 2.x. Response: pinned to cosign v1.13.0 and added note in docs.

Priya Shah: For air-gapped installs we need a way to inject the public key into the cluster operator. Can we add terraform outputs? Response: added terraform outputs and documented the secure distribution pattern.
Evan Garrison: Ensure SBOMs are reproducible and include buildkit metadata. Response: SBOM generation now includes build metadata and we added provenance.json with buildkit info.
Marco Liu: Can we support both keyless (OIDC) and key-based signing? Response: cosign wrapper supports keyless as default and key-based when COSIGN_KEY is provided; docs updated.
Priya Shah: CI flake observed on first run where signature upload raced with publish. Response: added retry/backoff and explicit upload ordering in release workflow.
Evan Garrison: Suggest adding schema validation for release-manifests.yaml in CI. Response: added a validation step to release workflow that enforces schema v1.
Marco Liu: Approved after small nits fixed.
merge_commit_message: squash: release(ci): artifact signing and provenance manifests for private installer
release_notes: Release pipeline: artifacts are now signed with sigstore/cosign and accompanied by provenance.json and SBOMs.
Generated release-manifests.yaml provides a single manifest of installer artifacts with checksums and signatures for offline validation.
Helm chart updated with provenance annotations and checksum validation support in the installer.
Terraform module extended to optionally verify artifact signatures during deployment.
Docs: operator guide for signature verification and air-gap key distribution added.
additional_notes: Ops action: publish cosign public key and manifest bucket ACL to operator teams before next deployment.
Migration: unsigned artifacts will be available for a 2-week migration window; signed artifacts are preferred.
Follow-up work: automate OIDC key rotation and add attestation publishing to internal registry (ENG-4823).
